describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile as a single quadrupedal chimera with a pale pink, smooth-skinned axolotl-like head, underbody, and limbs combined with a dense dorsal armor of overlapping dark brown-gray pangolin-like scales. It has a broad flat head with large dark eyes and six pink feathery external gills projecting from the neck behind the head, four stout wrinkled legs with clawed feet supporting the body, and a long thick tapering tail that is scaled dorsally and pale and ridged ventrally, the scales covering the entire back from the neck to the tail tip while the belly, throat, legs and underside of the tail remain exposed pale skin.

describe.description: A low-slung quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile with a broad, flat pale pink head with a rounded snout, large dark eyes, and six pink feathery external gill stalks behind the head. Its underside, neck, head and stout limbs are pale pinkish-white wrinkled soft skin, while its back, upper sides and the top of its long tapering tail are covered in dense overlapping large brown-gray rounded scales. It stands on four short amphibian-like legs with small clawed toes, and its thick tail extends to the left beyond the edge of the image.
